scope: CPU emitted-PTX conversion semantics; not sm120 MMA output parity

sources.contract: PTX E4M3 has no infinity; only 0x7f/0xff are NaN. E5M2 has 5 exponent and 2 mantissa bits.
cvt .rn ties to even; .satfinite preserves NaN class and saturates out-of-range magnitudes to sign-preserved MAX_NORM.
MMA accumulation order, rounding and handling of subnormal inputs are unspecified; conversion checks do not establish sm120 MMA parity.

finite_acceptance: bit exact including signed zero, saturation and subnormals
e5m2: Independent oracle landmarks/roundtrip only; absent from source PTX and unsupported by current rewriter
